en.Esse queijo vem cheio de larvas vivas, e: This cheese is full of live maggots, and they jump! And people eat it anyway.
en.É o casu marzu, da ilha da Sardenha, na: It's casu marzu, from the island of Sardinia, in Italy. Flies lay eggs in sheep's milk cheese, and the maggots hatch inside.
en.Elas digerem a gordura, e o queijo vai f: They digest the fat, and the cheese gets soft, almost liquid, with a super strong smell.
en.As larvas saltam até quinze centímetros!: The maggots can jump fifteen centimeters, about six inches! So people cover their bread with a hand while they eat.
en.O Guinness já chamou de queijo mais peri: Guinness once called it the most dangerous cheese in the world, and selling it is banned by hygiene rules.
en.Comenta: você teria coragem de provar? E: Comment: would you dare to taste it? And follow Maia, there's one of these every day!
